title: Other Health Insurance and TRICARE Select Payment on Lines Reprocessed for the Catastrophic Cap
content:
**Basis.** What TRICARE would pay as primary payer on a **TRICARE Select** cap-reprocessed line is the allowed amount times the attending share, less the beneficiary liability, never below zero. With other health insurance on file, the deductible and cost share of a line reprocessed for the catastrophic cap are figured on the allowed amount net of the other insurer's payment, and where the other insurer paid on it TRICARE pays second: where the provider is non-network nonparticipating, TRICARE pays the lesser of what it would pay as primary payer and the charge the provider may bill the beneficiary (the billed amount, never more than the allowed amount plus the tier's balance-billing limit percentage) less the other insurer's payment, times the attending share, less the beneficiary liability; where the provider is participating, TRICARE pays the allowed amount less the other insurer's payment, times the attending share, less the beneficiary liability; otherwise TRICARE pays what it would pay as primary payer. Each figure is rounded to the cent and never below zero.

On every TRICARE Select tier the balance-billing limit is 15 percent. Billed amount, allowed amount and the other insurer's payment come from the reversed line.

## Condition - result

| Other insurer paid on the line | Provider | TRICARE pays |
|---|---|---|
| yes | non-network nonparticipating | the lesser of the primary-payer amount and the capped billed amount less the other insurer's payment, times the attending share, less the liability |
| yes | participating | the allowed amount less the other insurer's payment, times the attending share, less the liability |
| no | any | the primary-payer amount |

## Hypothetical lines (attending share one, allowed 1000.00, liability 0.00)

- Participating, other insurer paid 700.00: 300.00.
- Nonparticipating, billed 1100.00, other insurer paid 700.00: 1100.00 is within 1150.00; 1100.00 less 700.00 is 400.00; the lesser of 1000.00 and 400.00: 400.00.
- No other insurer payment: 1000.00.
